trap.label: make out
trap.wrong: I can’t make the text out.
trap.right: I can’t make out the text.
trap.why: Em português não existe partícula; o brasileiro tenta “fazer” literal. Make out = distinguir; make up = inventar.

opts: I made an excuse up of.

fix.wrong: I can’t make the words out in the dark.
fix.right: I can’t make out the words in the dark.

fix.wrong: We made out for the delay.
fix.right: We made up for the delay.

rewrite.prompt: Use make up: “He invented an excuse.”
Use make out: “I can barely distinguish the text.”
rewrite.answer: I can barely make out the text.

rewrite.prompt: Use make up for: “We compensated the delay.”
rewrite.answer: We made up for the delay.
